node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic two-triple exclusion
node.statement: The W^2 coefficient of the exact two-cubic-fiber factorization forces rd+4(d^2+3d+3)=0. Combining this with the h=7 conic and the prior second quadratic leaves only (2d+3)(d+3)=0; the two base-field norms 9/4 and 9 are not eighth roots on any official row. Thus the cubic color partition 3+3 is empty.
node.notes: Exact proof-only exclusion of the 3+3 cubic color partition. It retires the 32 norm-gcd packets queued by the predecessor but says nothing about other cubic partitions.
